title: Require Habitat Rule Packet Topology
forbids: an open blueprint or repository-niche rule packet, a missing rule or baseline, or an executable source outside the canonical pattern.md and structure.toml names
why: Every reusable blueprint rule and repository-local niche rule is one closed policy packet. Stable packet names keep source and topology authority inside Habitat's native rule forms.
remediate: Keep rule.json and baseline.json in every blueprint or repository-niche rule packet, add only the selected pattern.md or structure.toml source, and remove unrelated files from the packet.
message: Habitat rule packets must retain one closed canonical policy surface.
